top_headline: الاسكندرية للزيوت المعدنية (AMOC.CA) - محضر اجتماع الجمعية العامة غير العادية (غير موثق)
llm_summary:
- Alexandria Mineral Oils Company (AMOC) held an extraordinary general meeting on November 14, 2026, with an unofficial meeting minutes document released on November 22, 2026.
- AMOC announced its independent financial results for the period from January 1, 2026, to September 30, 2026, with a net profit of EGP 3,003,921,347.
- The company also disclosed its consolidated financial results for the same period, reporting a net profit of EGP 3,474,921,150.
- On November 15, 2026, AMOC's Board of Directors made several decisions, which were announced along with a company statement and a review committee report.
- A summary of the extraordinary general meeting's decisions was released on the same day, with details available in Arabic and English.
- In a separate news article, it was reported that AMOC and Alexandria Container and Cargo Handling Company led the profit growth in the Egyptian stock market, with a season of financial results announcements underway.
- According to Egypt Oil & Gas, AMOC delivered a 154% increase in consolidated net profit after tax, reaching EGP 3.47 billion in the first nine months of 2026.
- AMOC's Board of Directors met on October 29, 2026, and made decisions regarding the company's performance indicators for the period ending September 30, 2026.
